in_marathi.name: Khairul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The Radiant One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khairul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Khaira', meaning 'to flourish or prosper'. It symbolizes the radiant and beautiful nature of the individual, and is believed to offer protection and blessings for a prosperous life.
